Language.Name: English
App.Title: CTPrep - Windows Reinstall Tool
Novice.Title: One-click reinstall
Novice.Warning: Reinstalling wipes drive C. Back up the files you want to keep to a USB drive or another disk before you start.
Novice.HintAuto:
Start reinstall needs nothing else from you: it detects this PC's edition, downloads the image and WinPE, then reboots into WinPE to install Windows unattended and set up the drivers.
An internet connection is required; keep the PC plugged in.
Novice.HintLocal: A local image is selected, so no image download is needed. WinPE is still downloaded.
Novice.HintVersion: Selected {0}: overrides the automatic match; the rest stays the same.
Info.Title: This computer
Image.Title: Image source
Image.LocalTooltip: A local file takes priority. Supports .iso / .wim / .esd
Install.Title: Install mode
Install.CrossDiskHint: The target disk is not the current system disk: every partition on disk {0} will be deleted and recreated, and Windows is installed there. The current system keeps its data, but the PC boots from this disk afterwards.
Install.Clean: Clean install (format the target partition, recommended)
Install.Wipe: Rebuild the whole disk (delete all partitions on the target disk and repartition)
Install.FormatBoot: Format the boot partition (clears old boot entries)
Install.FormatBootTooltip: The EFI system partition on UEFI, or the system reserved partition on BIOS. Formatting clears the old boot entries; leave it unchecked to keep the old contents (the old system stays bootable if the install fails halfway).
Install.IndexTooltip: 0 = automatic: an online image matches this PC's edition, falling back to Professional; a local multi-edition image opens a picker.
Unattend.Title: Unattended setup
Unattend.Enable: Enable unattended setup (skip OOBE, create a local account)
Unattend.ComputerTooltip: Leave empty to generate one automatically
Unattend.TimeZoneTooltip: Sorted by UTC offset; type to search.
Unattend.DisableDefenderTooltip: Writes the disable policies and stops the related services before the first sign-in. Recent Windows builds may restore it via tamper protection; confirm in Windows afterwards if needed.
Drivers.Title: Driver packages
Drivers.Hint: One per line: local folder / .zip / .exe / download URL
Behavior.Title: Behaviour
Behavior.Reboot: Reboot into WinPE automatically when preparation finishes
Behavior.Shutdown: Shut down after deployment (reboots by default)
Behavior.DryRun: Dry run (print the commands only, never touch disks or boot config)
Log.Title: Log
Status.RebootCancelFailed: Could not cancel the reboot. Run shutdown /a manually.
Confirm1.Title: Confirm your backup
Confirm1.Line1: Reinstalling deletes everything on drive C (Desktop, Documents, Downloads and so on).
Confirm1.Line2: Back up the files you want to keep to a USB drive or another disk first.
Confirm2.Title: Confirm the target
Confirm2.ModeClean: Mode: clean install (format the target partition)
Confirm2.ModeKeepFiles: Mode: keep files (clear the system directories)
Confirm2.WipeDisk: Whole-disk rebuild is enabled: every partition on the target disk will be deleted!
Confirm2.BootFormat: Boot partition: will be formatted and the boot files rebuilt
Confirm2.BootKeep: Boot partition: keeps the existing boot files
Confirm3.Title: Confirm to start
Confirm3.Real: Disks and boot configuration are rewritten and this cannot be undone automatically.
Confirm3.DryRun: Dry run: nothing on the disks changes.
Confirm3.Reboot: The PC reboots into WinPE 10 seconds after preparation; you can cancel during the countdown.
Edition.Title: Select the edition to install
Edition.Hint: The image contains multiple editions. Please select the one to install.

config.ini has no image address matching {0} in its [Image] section, and no Default fallback.
Click "Select a local image" to point at a .iso / .wim / .esd file instead.
Msg.LocalImageCleared: Local image cleared; falling back to the download address in config.ini.
Msg.RebootCancelFailed: Could not cancel the reboot (it may already have restarted, or the shutdown was not issued from here): {0}
Msg.NameNormalized: {0} "{1}" contains invalid characters or is too long; changed to "{2}" to satisfy the Windows naming rules.
Msg.ComputerNameRandom: Computer name "{0}" has no usable characters left after normalising; a random name will be generated.
Progress.ReadEditions: Reading the editions inside the image...
Progress.PrepareStaging: Preparing the staging partition (the volume may need shrinking)...
Progress.CopyPayload: Copying the image and driver packages to the staging partition...
Progress.RebootSoon: Rebooting into the WinPE deployment environment in 10 seconds...
Progress.DryRunDone: Dry run finished, nothing was changed.
Msg.DryRunNotice: Dry run: only the commands are printed. Disks and boot configuration stay untouched.
Msg.NoEsp:
UEFI firmware detected, but the target disk has no EFI system partition (it may be an MBR/CSM setup).
Choose "Rebuild the whole disk" in Advanced to create a GPT/EFI layout, or convert the system disk to GPT first.
Msg.StagingOnTargetDisk:
Rebuilding the whole disk converts disk {0} from {1} to {2}, but the staging partition also lives on that disk, so the conversion would delete the staged data as well.
Convert the system disk to the target partition table with another tool first, or leave a large enough NTFS partition on a different disk.
Msg.DiskTooLargeForMbr: The target disk {0} (about {1} TB) exceeds 2 TB, which MBR cannot address. Choose "Rebuild the whole disk" in Advanced to use GPT instead.
Msg.TargetDiskGone: The selected target disk (disk {0}) no longer exists. Click "Re-detect" to refresh the disk list and try again.
Msg.CrossDiskChosen: A disk other than the system disk is used as the target: {0}. It will be rebuilt completely.
Msg.RunOnCDriveTitle: Run CTPrep from a drive other than C:
Msg.RunOnCDriveBody:
CTPrep is running from drive C.

The system partition is shrunk and formatted during reinstallation, so a copy on C: can be locked, break the deployment or leave broken partitions behind.

Copy the whole CTPrep folder to another partition (for example D:\CTPrep) and run it from there.

Current folder: {0}
